Source: WHO AFRO DDC/CSR EPR - Update on current outbreaks as of 30 September 2005 (cholera, Gambia entry)
Description: WHO Regional Office for Africa, Division of Prevention and Control of Communicable Diseases (DDC), CSR/EPR, 'Update on current outbreaks as of 30 September 2005' (10 pp, archived copy of www.afro.who.int/csr/epr/current_epidemics/sept_2005.pdf). Cholera entry 7. GAMBIA: 'Affected areas: All Regions are affected, except Upper River Division (URD). Onset: 7th September 2004 [sic; the September 2005 wave - Gambia is absent from the April 2005 update and OCHA dates the first cases 8-23 Sep 2005]. Description of the occurrence: The index case traveled to Senegal and Guinea Bissau where there are cholera outbreak. He was burial without hygienic precaution. Cumulative number of cases: The cumulative number of cases in the country is 54 as of 30th September 2005. Cumulative number of deaths: As of 30th September 2005, 2 deaths were reported. Case fatality rate: 3,7 %. Laboratory confirmation: Vibrio cholerae, serogroup 01, serotype Ogawa identified. Actions taken: Case management, surveillance strengthening, sensitization of population, distribution of drinking safe water.' Companion April 2005 update (current_epidemics/april_2005.pdf) lists no Gambian cholera.

Source: WHO AFRO DDC EPR/CSR - Weekly outbreak/epidemics monitoring sheet as of week 38, 2005
Description: WHO AFRO DDC 'Weekly outbreak/epidemics monitoring sheet, as of week 38, 2005' (4 pp; archived copy of www.afro.who.int/csr/epr/epidemic_prone_diseases/weekly_feedback1-38_2005.pdf). Cholera row: 'GAMBIA | Affected areas ? | Onset (index case) Week 1 of 2005 | Cumulative number of cases 38 | Cumulative number of deaths 2 | CFR 5,2 | Laboratory confirmation ? | Case management, Surveillance strengthening, Sensitization of population | Source WHO | Date of last update 18/09/05 (Week 37) | Remarks CFR >1%'.
